annotations.title: Wait for the answer to a review

description: Wait for the human's answers to ONE review (from mnemosyne_review_open), from the app or from their phone. Returns every answer given after `after`, oldest first: verdict approve / changes / reject, or null for a plain comment (the human can send frame notes alone, without a verdict), plus the text (a voice note arrives transcribed) and the second of the video it points at when they gave one. From the app an answer can carry frame notes: exact frame numbers (counted at the fps shown), each with what to fix there. Pass `after` (the createdAt of the review, or the `after` the last result told you) so an answer given before you started waiting is not missed. ONE CALL WAITS AT MOST ~45 s, so it never outlives your client's own tool timeout. When it returns STILL WAITING, nothing was decided: call it again with the same id and the same after, in a loop, for as long as you mean to listen. The human sees in the panel whether an agent is listening. Needs the Mnemosyne OS app RUNNING: on macOS its window may be closed (the app stays up and the host reads the file); on Windows and Linux closing the last window quits the app, so it must be open. Scope review:ask.

after.description: Epoch ms: only answers strictly after this count. Default: now.

timeout_seconds.description: How long this one call waits, default and max 45 (raised only by MNEMO_REVIEW_WAIT_MAX_S for a client known to wait longer). To listen longer, call again on STILL WAITING.

name: mnemosyne_review_wait
